jobs.title: Senior System Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

The HUK-COBURG Versicherungsgruppe is one of the largest insurance providers in Germany, with a rich history spanning over 90 years. Founded with a commitment to offering affordable insurance solutions, the company has grown to serve more than 13 million customers, making it a leading player in the private household and automobile insurance sectors. Known for its competitive pricing and strong reputation, HUK-COBURG prides itself on being a reliable and innovative employer. With a workforce of over 10,000 employees, 770 different job profiles, and 35 departments, the organization offers a multitude of career opportunities. The company fosters a culture of teamwork, personal growth, and shared success, emphasizing the importance of individual development aligned with organizational goals.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior System Developer SAP FS-CD (w/m/d) to join our dynamic IT team in Coburg, Bayern. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in the implementation and ongoing development of SAP FS-CD as the central in-/ex-cash system for our insurance processes. Your expertise will help optimize our technical infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration and functionality of our insurance systems. You will collaborate closely with business units to analyze requirements, design tailored IT solutions, and develop complex processes, services, and interfaces. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in an agile environment, contributing to innovative projects that directly impact our operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Your work will support our mission to deliver high-quality insurance services through cutting-edge technology and expert solutions.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a university degree in (business) informatics or a comparable field, or alternatively, hold a recognized qualification as a Fachinformatiker:in. You should have several years of experience in developing and managing complex SAP solutions, particularly with a focus on S/4HANA, ABAP, ABAP OO, and OData-Services. A strong understanding of SAP ERP modules, especially FS-CD and FI-CA, is essential, along with a solid grasp of business processes within the insurance industry. Knowledge of insurance products and their accounting representations is advantageous. The role requires excellent analytical skills to quickly understand complex issues, along with a proactive attitude towards coaching and sharing knowledge within the team. High responsibility awareness, structured and autonomous working style, along with strong communication and collaboration skills, are critical. Proficiency in German at a C1 level or higher is necessary for effective communication within our organization.

Responsibilities

You will actively participate in the deployment of SAP FS-CD as a core system for our insurance processes, ensuring its integration and functionality align with business needs. Your tasks include analyzing detailed requirements in collaboration with our business units, designing and implementing tailored IT solutions using agile methodologies, and developing complex processes, interfaces, and services. You will customize SAP FS-CD, develop user exits, business add-ins, and reports to meet specific business requirements. Working closely with internal specialists and external service providers, you will ensure the technical robustness and efficiency of our SAP solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, provide technical support, and ensure compliance with best practices and organizational standards.

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their personal and professional well-being. We offer employer contributions, including a performance-oriented remuneration structure with 13.3 monthly salaries, mobility allowances, and asset-building benefits. To foster growth, we provide various training programs, subsidies for self-education, and access to our dedicated training center. Flexibility is key; employees can work up to half of their working hours remotely, promoting a healthy work-life balance. We provide flexible working hours, 31.5 vacation days, and time off during Christmas and New Year’s Eve. For working parents and caregivers, we offer support for childcare, eldercare, and part-time leadership roles. Our health and wellness programs include initiatives related to physical activity, nutrition, mental health, and subsidized memberships at fitness centers. We also promote retirement planning through company pension schemes, employee counseling services, and incentives like subsidized bicycles to encourage eco-friendly commuting.

Equal Opportunity

HUK-COBURG Versicherungsgruppe is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, religion, or sexual orientation. We believe that diversity enhances our innovation, collaboration, and overall success. Our hiring practices and workplace policies are designed to promote fairness, respect, and equal access to career development opportunities for everyone. We strive to create an environment where all employees can thrive and reach their full potential.

Długość umowy: > 12 miesięcy + możliwość przedłużenia.

Tworzenie rozwiązań zgodnych z podejściem Domain Driven Design (DDD).

Tworzenie oraz utrzymywanie testów jednostkowych i integracyjnych z wykorzystaniem JUnit 5, Mockito oraz RestAssured.
Monitorowanie, diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów aplikacyjnych przy użyciu ELK, Dynatrace oraz Redis.
Współpraca z zespołem w procesie dostarczania oprogramowania z wykorzystaniem narzędzi CI/CD.
Wsparcie rozwoju i utrzymania wysokodostępnych systemów transakcyjnych działających w środowisku finansowym.

Wymagania:

Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia komercyjnego w rozwoju aplikacji Java.
Bardzo dobra znajomość Java 21+.
Praktyczne doświadczenie ze Spring Boot 3 oraz Hibernate.

Bardzo dobra znajomość PostgreSQL.
Doświadczenie z RabbitMQ oraz Kafka.

Doświadczenie z narzędziami CI/CD: GitLab, Jenkins oraz OpenShift.
Umiejętność pracy przy rozwoju złożonych systemów backendowych.

Preferowane umiejętności:

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Engineer
🚀

Stockholm or Helsingborg, Sweden 📍
Hybrid

We’re looking for something a little different.

AI is changing how software is built.

Writing code is becoming easier. Understanding  what to build, why it matters, and whether it’s the right solution
 is becoming more important.

We’re looking for someone who is  technically curious, driven and interested in both technology and the business behind it.

You don’t need to be a senior developer.

You don’t need previous POS experience.

But you should enjoy solving problems, asking questions and taking ownership.

What you’ll do

Build software used by thousands of merchants
Understand real customer and business problems and turn them into solutions
Work with payments, sales, refunds, loyalty and inventory
Challenge requirements and help shape what should be built
Work closely with Product, Support and Engineering
Use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude and Codex to explore, build, test and improve software
Own your work from idea to production

What we’re looking for

A strong technical mindset and the ability to solve problems with technology
Good engineering judgement and problem-solving skills
Curiosity about how customers and businesses actually work
Ability to learn quickly and work independently
Interest in making AI a fundamental part of how you work
Drive, ownership and willingness to learn
Fluent in both Swedish and English

Experience with  C#/.NET or another modern technology stack
 is valuable, but we care more about how you think and learn than the technologies on your CV.

Experience with  POS, payments, retail, hospitality, commerce or ERP
 is a big plus.

🤖 Our view on AI

AI is becoming a fundamental part of how we engineer.

Use it to explore systems, build, test, investigate and work faster.

But don’t blindly trust it.

You are responsible for understanding the solution, challenging it and making sure it is right.

AI gives you leverage.

Engineering judgement gives that leverage direction.

🏪 Why join us?

Our POS platform is used by  thousands of businesses across the Nordics every day
.
The problems are real. A payment failure matters. A wrong refund matters. A slow checkout matters.

If you want to do more than implement requirements — and want to understand the problem, shape the solution and use AI to amplify what you can achieve —  we’d love to hear from you.

Come build the future of POS with us.

About Confirma Software

Confirma Software is a fast-growing Nordic technology group focused on innovation and long-term value creation.
Today, we consist of  29 software companies
 across multiple verticals, including POS, ERP, Payroll, Access Control and more. We continue to grow through acquisitions.

This is an opportunity to combine the  stability of a strong Nordic software group
 with the energy of building a  next-generation platform
.

Welcome with your application!

Contact,

Karsten Ahlberg

Enginering Manager POS
karsten.ahlberg@crona.se
